capabilities: Runs a fresh interactive Bash session in an Obsidian tab
Manages the PTY, shell, and process lifecycle through a local Rust bridge
Installs the bridge as a Termux runit service with checksum verification
Authenticates each connection with a loopback-only token
extras: Bridge listens on 127.0.0.1 only; tokens expire after six months with a warning in the final seven days; a hardware keyboard is required; terminal data, tokens, and shell output are not recorded by default.
problem: Obsidian on Android gives no way to run a real native shell without leaving the app.

relations.evidence: Use a real native Termux shell inside Obsidian on Android.

requires.name: bridge connection token printed by the installer

summary: Android plugin that embeds a real Termux shell in an Obsidian tab via a local Rust PTY bridge.
